title: Hangman Extended
story: You built basic Hangman. Now level it up: word categories (Animals, Countries, Movies), score tracking across multiple rounds, and an ASCII hangman that draws progressively. This is the version you'd actually share with friends.
why: Extended Hangman builds on the basic version with categories, multi-round scoring, and visual feedback — a polished, complete game.
analogy: A TV game show where each round has a different theme and the stakes get higher. Round 1: Animals (easy). Round 2: Programming Languages (harder). Round 3: Movie Titles (hardest). The hangman drawing builds tension like a countdown timer — each wrong guess brings the stick figure closer to completion.
try_it: Add 5 categories with 5+ words each. Add difficulty levels that adjust lives (Easy=8, Medium=6, Hard=4). Implement a hint system: after 3 wrong guesses, reveal one random letter. Track and display high scores across sessions.
tips: Organize words by category — easier to manage and more fun for players
Score by word length × remaining lives × difficulty multiplier
Draw hangman progressively — visual feedback creates tension
common_mistakes: Not resetting lives between rounds — each round is fresh
Reusing guessed letters across rounds — reset the guessed list
Forgetting to update both the display AND the found-letter count
